component.name: Race Track Visualizer
component.summary: Telemetry overlays for action camera video

description.p: Puts the data of a ride or a track day on its video: speed, lap times, G-force, the track map, heart rate, power, OBD data and more, drawn as gauges over the footage and exported as a new video.

ul.li: FIT, GPX and TCX files, or the data a GoPro wrote into the video, synchronized automatically
Gauges placed and sized with the mouse, templates, and a gauge editor
Laps and sectors timed from lines placed on the route
Routes on street maps, elevation from a terrain model
Export with the graphics card's encoder, music, cuts, and a command line
